top_signals.title: London Tube exhibition celebrates ghosts of the Underground and screeching sound of tracks
top_signals.summary: The ominous presence of a ghost at Bethnal Green Tube station, a melange of colour left behind from torn off posters at Bank and burly rain clouds cloaking Three Colts Lane. These are sights featured in the paintings in Jock McFadyen with Jem Finer’s Underground (and Surface) Exhibition now showing at the Guildhall Art Gallery.  [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Europe Gas Fluctuates as Traders Weigh German Stockpiling Moves
top_signals.summary: European natural gas fluctuated as traders weighed Germany’s next moves to boost winter stockpiles, which could determine fuel demand from the county in the coming months.
